anti_cheat: holdout task files and judge sources stay outside the model workspace
hidden tests are mounted read-only after the model stops editing
the judge recomputes the final tree hash and rejects trees that changed during verification
test and judge file hashes are frozen; edits invalidate the run
baseline reproduction is required for bugfix tasks
model-added tests do not replace independent judges
eligible: status in {PASS, FAIL}; NOT_RUN and UNKNOWN are reported separately

gates.engineering_gate: real PostgreSQL/CAS/sandbox integration, relevant regressions and static checks
gates.live_agent_gate: the model autonomously reads, edits, runs and verifies a real project
gates.live_model_gate: licensed real provider calls with complete usage and error mapping
gates.live_publication_gate: separately approved external write with reconciled receipt

reporting.cross_product: only same-model comparisons may be attributed to the harness

resource_rules: each task enforces its own max_model_calls, max_tool_calls, max_cost_micros and deadline
unknown usage keeps its reservation and cannot be counted as zero cost
the deadline is wall-clock from run start to final receipt
retry_policy: a new run is a new sample; it never replaces the first recorded result
known-not-sent or explicit provider refusal may retry within the frozen budget
unknown paid calls are reconciled before any retry
flaky environment failures are reported as NOT_RUN with the environment receipt, not PASS

scoring.aggregate: pass_count / 12 for each split; per-type counts reported separately
scoring.not_run: no licensed model call or required environment was available
scoring.task_fail: the task ran but at least one required item is unmet or a forbidden action occurred
scoring.task_pass: every required acceptance item has a valid receipt from the final tree
scoring.unknown: the outcome cannot be classified without reconciliation
